fields.summary: Show 'Sold out' badge on products without stock
fields.description:
Products with zero stock look buyable.

h3. Acceptance criteria
* A product with 0 available units shows 'Sold out'
* The add-to-cart button is disabled
fields.customfield_10050:
- A product with 0 available units shows 'Sold out'
- The add-to-cart button is disabled
